title: Is Solana the Ethereum killer? 2026 update

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Solana's 50,000 TPS and 400ms finality make it a clear Ethereum killer in 2026.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Ethereum's Layer 2s and EIP-4844 are closing the gap, with real user adoption and security.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Solana's PoH and unique consensus model outperform Ethereum's energy-heavy PoS in scalability.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Ethereum’s active developer community and decentralized infrastructure can't be matched by Solana's centralized nodes.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Solana may be fast, but Ethereum’s future is secure, scalable, and unstoppable.
